correctness.rationale: The exact integer ice rules h_{r,c}+v_{r,c}=h_{r,c−1}+v_{r−1,c} characterize 2-in/2-out orientations on the 3x3 periodic simple four-regular grid. Independent complete full enumeration of all 2^18 edge words produced exactly 148 states. Recomputed unnormalized integer Walsh transform on the whole cube reproduced every signed histogram entry, 162816 zeros, rank99328, min |W|4. The Eulerian bit words lie in the binary 10-dimensional cycle space, forcing 256-fold repeats by the 8-dimensional orthogonal cut space. Recomputed inverse Walsh of nonzero support gives absolute sum1,822,720/262144=445/64; translation averaging proves it is the optimum among all linear projections. Source SPECTRUM.json has all 1024 quotient coefficients, and source check_ice3.py independently describes two complete orientation enumerations; full finite exhaustion is appropriate to this exact finite claim.

evidence: Jacobsen–Jiang–Zhang solve general MxN torus partition functions at isotropic local weights and analyze their polynomial zeros, not all edge Walsh characters; Tavares–Ribeiro–Korepin address entropy/boundaries.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Larger lattice parameter coverage in a restricted weighting regime does not imply the finite all-edge-sign transform or endpoint Fourier projection norm.
